chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

I did not see the people taking from al-Hasan and al-Husayn (peace be upon him) except for the prayer after 'Asr and after the morning (Fajr) during the obligatory Tashriq) in the Tawaf of the Fard (obligatory pilgrimage).

key_terms.بَعْدَ الْغَدَاةِ: After the morning (referring to the time after Fajr prayer until sunrise/Tashriq)

ai.seo_question: When should the two cycles of prayer be performed during the Tawaf of the Ka'bah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the established Sunnah of performing two cycles of prayer during the Tawaf, specifically noting the timing after 'Asr and after the morning prayer (Fajr). This narration underscores the integration of ritual movement with devotional stillness, reflecting the Shia emphasis on adhering to the Prophet's and Imams' customary practices (Sunnah) in enhancing the spiritual quality of Hajj rituals. The specific timing suggests a continuity of worship, linking the physical act of circumambulation with dedicated periods of supplication and reflection.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Is’haq, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Iasws did not see the people taking from Al-Hassanasws and Al-Husaynasws except for the Prayer after Al-Asr, and after the morning regarding the Obligatory Tawaaf’.
en.sarwar: 5. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
I do not see people follow al-Hassan and al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, in Salat (prayer) except Salat (prayer) after al-‘Asr (sunset) and after the morning (sunrise) in obligatory Tawaf.’”
